patthana23.35:1.1: dhammo uppannassa kusalassa dhammassa ārammaṇa paccayena paccayo. hetuyā satta,
patthana23.35:2.1: na uppanno na akusalo dhammo uppannassa akusalassa dhammassa ārammaṇa paccayena paccayo.
patthana23.35:5.1: hetuyā cha. na uppanno na abyākato dhammo uppannassa abyākatassa dhammassa ārammaṇa paccayena paccayo. ārammaṇe satta,
patthana23.35:6.1: (atītattikaṃ uppannattika sadisaṃ). na atītārammaṇaṃ na kusalaṃ
